experiment: K=4 joint-target bundles on the fixed diverse-continuation 1,000-batch exposure
distance: squared Euclidean distance over four absolute joint targets normalized by 180 degrees
source_selection: MOVE labels only from the exact 192+32+32 fixed batches; no validation, padding, non-move labels, or student states
weighting: integer number of appearances in the fixed batches, including repeated rows and ID representations; these appearances are not extra demonstrations
sample_order: source order base, old_continuation, new_continuation; then ascending original pool index
numeric: NumPy float64 fitting of original float32 q/180 targets; integer exposure weights
initialization: one seeded weighted k-means++ run using NumPy PCG64: draw first by exposure, later draws by exposure times nearest squared distance; no restarts
tie_rule: lowest center index via NumPy argmin; initialization cumulative draws use right-side search
convergence: all unique sample assignments equal to the previous complete assignment
empty_cluster: record centers, counts, iteration and empty IDs, stop; no reassignment, reseed, retry or K change
iteration_limit: record centers and counts, stop without training if assignments have not converged
lineage_failure: record failure and stop; never infer an unknown source or use a substitute target
teacher_stage_use: evidence and diagnostic stratification only; never a student feature
baseline: diverse-continuation MLP64 final 1,000-update checkpoint with saved 7/12 and 0/6 results
training: original tail-average MLP64 initialization, same fixed 1,000 batches, new Adam 1e-5; action CE plus MOVE-only bundle CE at weight 1 plus target-bundle residual MSE at weight 100
evaluation: deterministic argmax bundle, first index on tie; no action clipping or replacement
